findings.subject: Email address
findings.message: Email address is declared as collected and has no purpose
findings.fix: Give the data type at least one purpose: Google asks for the purposes of every data type that is collected or shared

findings.subject: Google Analytics for Firebase - Approximate location
findings.message: Google Analytics for Firebase (com.google.firebase:firebase-analytics) is a dependency and collects by default "Masked IP address", which Google's page puts under Approximate location (Location); examples/android-app/data-safety.json does not list it
findings.fix: Add Approximate location to examples/android-app/data-safety.json with its purposes, or remove the SDK; the vendor's page is https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11582702

findings.subject: Google Analytics for Firebase - Purchase history
findings.message: Google Analytics for Firebase (com.google.firebase:firebase-analytics) is a dependency and collects by default "In-app purchases and subscriptions", which Google's page puts under Purchase history (Financial info); examples/android-app/data-safety.json does not list it
findings.fix: Add Purchase history to examples/android-app/data-safety.json with its purposes, or remove the SDK; the vendor's page is https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11582702

findings.subject: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
findings.message: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS is in the manifest, and examples/android-app/data-safety.json says Contacts is neither collected nor shared (line 28)
findings.fix: Check that no data of this type leaves the device through the app, a library or a webview; if some does, set collected or shared to true and give the purposes

findings.subject: Analytic
findings.message: "Analytic" is not a purpose that Google's Data safety page lists
findings.fix: Write the purpose exactly as Google writes it, for example "App functionality"; docs/data-safety-answers.md lists them all

findings.subject: android.permission.CAMERA
findings.message: android.permission.CAMERA can mean Photos or Videos, depending on what the app does with the data, and examples/android-app/data-safety.json lists none of them
findings.fix: Decide what the app does with it: if it collects or shares Photos or Videos, add it to examples/android-app/data-safety.json with its purposes; if the data stays on the device, nothing is needed
